{"question":"按叙述顺序仅检索岔路水闸记录1及此前章节。","operation":"chapter-cutoff","view":"author","branch":"canon","retrievalStatus":"matched","diagnostics":[],"documents":[{"documentId":"D1","title":"已确认揭示","kind":"disclosure","text":"山坡果农采摘成熟山梨，不从旱渠取水，也不进入值守室。","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"audienceKeys":["author"],"sequenceKey":"chapters:world/W-IXYPS-HKJ6","spanRef":"evidence:v1:chapter%3Ares%3Av1%3Achapter%3A466e80cf-ec25-41a4-b6f8-998c480bb381:sub%3Av1%3A00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000101:literal","subjectRefs":[],"unitKey":"res:v1:chapter:466e80cf-ec25-41a4-b6f8-998c480bb381"},"supporting":[]},"evidence":["山坡果农采摘成熟山梨，不从旱渠取水，也不进入值守室。"]},{"documentId":"D2","title":"已确认揭示","kind":"disclosure","text":"周汀听信传言，以为旱渠已经有水；江岑知道正史北闸仍关着。江岑依据关闸现状保留闸锁，未登记送水完成。","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"audienceKeys":["author"],"sequenceKey":"chapters:world/W-IXYPS-HKJ6","spanRef":"evidence:v1:chapter%3Ares%3Av1%3Achapter%3A510a04b9-a330-4bc7-b9ba-d7127ae79bfc:sub%3Av1%3A00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000101:literal","subjectRefs":[],"unitKey":"res:v1:chapter:510a04b9-a330-4bc7-b9ba-d7127ae79bfc"},"supporting":[]},"evidence":["周汀听信传言，以为旱渠已经有水；江岑知道正史北闸仍关着。江岑依据关闸现状保留闸锁，未登记送水完成。"]},{"documentId":"D3","title":"已确认揭示","kind":"disclosure","text":"正史分支中北闸保持关闭，江岑把闸锁放在值守室；另有未执行的开闸假设。水闸规约写明：只有北闸实际开启，水才会进入旱渠。值守室墙上挂着一幅旧地图。","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"audienceKeys":["author"],"sequenceKey":"chapters:world/W-IXYPS-HKJ6","spanRef":"evidence:v1:chapter%3Ares%3Av1%3Achapter%3A541242c6-7fc3-469d-961f-01e1fc103b2a:sub%3Av1%3A00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000101:literal","subjectRefs":[],"unitKey":"res:v1:chapter:541242c6-7fc3-469d-961f-01e1fc103b2a"},"supporting":[]},"evidence":["正史分支中北闸保持关闭，江岑把闸锁放在值守室；另有未执行的开闸假设。水闸规约写明：只有北闸实际开启，水才会进入旱渠。值守室墙上挂着一幅旧地图。"]},{"documentId":"D4","title":"已确认揭示","kind":"disclosure","text":"江岑确认北闸仍关，送水目标继续受阻；周汀依据开闸传言把货车驶向无水的旱渠。","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"audienceKeys":["author"],"sequenceKey":"chapters:world/W-IXYPS-HKJ6","spanRef":"evidence:v1:chapter%3Ares%3Av1%3Achapter%3Ace1c79f6-faff-400f-9e87-f7fb09304f40:sub%3Av1%3A00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000101:literal","subjectRefs":[],"unitKey":"res:v1:chapter:ce1c79f6-faff-400f-9e87-f7fb09304f40"},"supporting":[]},"evidence":["江岑确认北闸仍关，送水目标继续受阻；周汀依据开闸传言把货车驶向无水的旱渠。"]}]}
